name: Power! A lotta power! It's great!
finding: A GameFAQs discussion explicitly asks about the exact Super Soul's Limit Burst. A responder identifies the Limit Burst as Power Ki Blast with Auto Health and Stamina Up and DEF Down.

canonical_changes.limit_burst_effect: Auto Health and Stamina Up; DEF Down

evidence_limits: The source establishes the Limit Burst type/effect but does not establish a trigger condition.
No additional timing, activation rule, or engine-level behavior was inferred.
The community source is item-specific but secondary; no stronger item-level source was located in this bounded pass.
result: Limit Burst type and effect resolved; trigger remains null. Super Soul 217 is removed from the strict-thin queue because all strict core fields are now populated.
